exceptions.exposure_assessment: The desktop crate does not directly import glib, gtk, or VariantStrIter. Exposure is transitive and limited to Tauri's Linux/BSD GTK3 stack.
exceptions.justification: Tauri 2.11.5 is the latest supported v2 release and still requires gtk/glib 0.18. The upstream fix exists only in glib 0.20; no supported Tauri v2 upgrade removes the affected dependency.
exceptions.remediation_trigger: Remove this exception when a supported Tauri release no longer depends on gtk/glib 0.18, or when an official 0.18 backport becomes available.
